main.cpp: In function ‘int main()’:
main.cpp:8:22: error: expected ‘;’ before ‘std’
    8 |     int v = square(7)
      |                      ^
      |                      ;
    9 |     std::cout << v << std::endl;
      |     ~~~
output:
## Why
The compiler reports the error at `std` on line 9 of `main.cpp`, but the real problem is the statement just before it (line 8, `int v = square(7)`), which has no terminating semicolon.
## Fix
Add the missing semicolon at the end of line 8.
```cpp
int v = square(7);
```
GCC usually reports a missing `;` on the line after the one that needs it.

input: 1>main.cpp(6,13): error C3861: “add”: 找不到标识符
output:
## Why
`main.cpp` 第 6 行调用 `add` 时,编译器还没有见过它的声明(C3861)。如果 `add` 的定义写在 `main` 的后面,就会出现这种情况。
## Fix
在 `main` 之前加一行函数声明,或者把整个函数移到 `main` 前面。
```cpp
int add(int, int);
```
这里的参数和返回类型以你实际的 `add` 为准。

$ g++ -fsanitize=address -g main.cpp -o app && ./app
=================================================================
==24817==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow on address 0x603000000054 at pc 0x5594d0c3e3a6 bp 0x7ffc0f6e0d70 sp 0x7ffc0f6e0d60
WRITE of size 4 at 0x603000000054 thread T0
    #0 0x5594d0c3e3a5 in main /home/kai/lab/main.cpp:8
    #1 0x7f6b8a829d8f in __libc_start_call_main ../sysdeps/nptl/libc_start_call_main.h:58

0x603000000054 is located 0 bytes to the right of 20-byte region [0x603000000040,0x603000000054)
output:
## Why
AddressSanitizer caught a 4-byte write at `main.cpp:8` that lands 0 bytes past the end of a 20-byte heap block, which is exactly 5 `int`s. So the code writes to index 5 of an array that only has indexes 0–4.
## Fix
Keep the index inside the allocated size, or allocate more.
```cpp
a[4] = 100;  // last valid index of new int[5]
```
This assumes the block comes from `new int[5]`; if it is larger in your code, check the size used at the allocation.

$ ./app
1
released
free(): double free detected in tcache 2
Aborted (core dumped)
output:
## Why
glibc detected the same heap block being freed twice (`double free`) and aborted. This usually means two pointers to one allocation were both passed to `delete`/`free`, or a pointer was deleted again after it was already released. The message has no line number; `released` shows the first free already happened.
## Fix
Release each allocation exactly once and null the pointers afterwards.
```cpp
delete[] data;
data = nullptr;
copy = nullptr;  // same block, do not delete it again
```
Using `std::vector` or `std::unique_ptr` avoids manual deletes.

output:
## Why
报错位置在第 11 行的 `return` 前面,说明编译器读到 `return` 时,上一条语句还没有以分号结束。真正漏掉 `;` 的通常是第 11 行之前的那一行。
## Fix
给上一行语句补上分号。
```cpp
cout << "面积: " << w * h << endl;
```
这里的语句内容以你的上一行为准,关键是行尾要有 `;`。

## Why
输出 `120` 之后程序崩溃,说明第一次调用正常,第二次调用时出了问题。段错误没有行号;如果这里用到了递归,常见原因是递归缺少终止条件(例如参数为负数时永远走不到 `n == 0`),调用栈耗尽后触发段错误。
## Fix
让终止条件覆盖所有可能的输入。
```cpp
if (n <= 0) return 1;
```
函数的名字和判断条件以你的递归函数为准。

1>main.cpp(7,5): error C4996: “strcpy”: This function or variable may be unsafe. Consider using strcpy_s instead. To disable deprecation, use _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS. See online help for details.
output:
## Why
Visual Studio treats `strcpy` on line 7 of `main.cpp` as unsafe (no buffer-size check) and, with the default settings, turns that deprecation warning into error C4996.
## Fix
Use the checked version, or disable the warning for a school project.
```cpp
strcpy_s(name, sizeof(name), "Zhang San");
```
Alternatively, put `#define _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS` at the very top of the file, before any `#include`.
